marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF510B 20V MAX Series ratchet features a 3/8 in square drive, 75 ft-lb torque rating, and variable speed trigger for optimal control. It includes an interchangeable anvil with 3/8 in and 1/4 in square drive options as well as 1/4 in hex quick release. The tool also features an LED work light to illuminate dark workspaces.
